The indexed supply is the Ethereum suppl: The indexed supply is the Ethereum supply, not Ink's native ETH balance. A verified Ink denominator is required for this percentage.

List endpoints return items and next_pag: List endpoints return items and next_page_params. Detail endpoints return one object. Missing values remain null.

Copy every next_page_params key into the: Copy every next_page_params key into the next request. Null means the end of the list. Do not calculate block offsets or reuse a cursor with different filters.
Filtered pages may be short or empty whi: Filtered pages may be short or empty while a next cursor remains. Continue with that cursor; results are deduplicated by parent hash.
Blocks arrive on node events. Transactio: Blocks arrive on node events. Transactions may appear before their receipts; only status ok confirms successful execution. Replace blocks by height and hash after a reorganization.
Opt in using the WebSocket subprotocol. Reset frames replace local state; later frames merge blocks by height and transactions by hash. Remove transactions from replaced blocks and outside the reported window. Utilization covers 30 canonical blocks.
Transaction search allows 4 concurrent q: Transaction search allows 4 concurrent queries and 60 queries per minute across this instance. A query scans at most 3 source pages. Other routes follow upstream limits. Retry 429 responses using Retry-After and exponential backoff.
Wei amounts are decimal strings. Use Big: Wei amounts are decimal strings. Use BigInt and token decimals; do not convert raw balances to floating-point numbers. ETH uses 18 decimals. Chart units are declared by the metric catalogue.
Blocks and receipts come from the local: Blocks and receipts come from the local node. Historical records and charts currently come from the Ink index. Check X-Ink-Data-Status and X-Ink-Data-Fetched-At when present; retained data is not a fresh observation.
The latest chart interval can be incompl: The latest chart interval can be incomplete. UTC-day counters and trailing 24-hour counters describe different periods. Total fees include L2 execution and L1 data charges; inspect receipt fields for operator charges.
Gas used divided by gas capacity across: Gas used divided by gas capacity across the latest 30 canonical blocks.
Blocks replaced by another canonical bra: Blocks replaced by another canonical branch. Their transactions may be included again in a different block.
